text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
W-We've got an emergency--!!
An agitated pit bull got loose--!!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Baring your fangs at me
is certainly spirited. However—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: We're in a public park... Show a little more restraint, won't you?

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: T-That pit bull was rampaging like crazy just now, and now it's like a totally different dog...!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Because of the delay caused by this incident,
Gentildonna ended up being late
for her training session."
